faculty.name: Woo-kyoung Ahn
faculty.summary: Studies how people learn and represent concepts and causal relations, and how these processes affect thinking and clinical diagnoses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何学习和表征概念及因果关系，以及这些过程如何影响思维和临床诊断。

faculty.name: Arielle Baskin-Sommers
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive-affective deficits associated with disinhibition in psychopathology, using interdisciplinary methods to develop syndrome-specific interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与心理障碍相关的抑制不足的认知情感缺陷，使用跨学科方法开发特定综合征的干预措施。

faculty.name: Dani S. Bassett
faculty.summary: Studies dynamic changes in network architecture and their influence on system function in physical and biological systems, including brain connectivity and cognitive development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究网络结构动态变化及其对系统功能的影响，包括物理和生物系统中的网络结构以及大脑连接性和认知发展。

faculty.name: Tyrone Cannon
faculty.summary: Studies the interplay between psychological phenomena and neurobiological mechanisms in people with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, focusing on the emergence of psychosis and developing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理现象与神经生物学机制在精神分裂症和双相情感障碍患者中的相互作用，特别是精神病症状的出现及其预防策略。

faculty.name: Nicolò Cesana-Arlotti
faculty.summary: Studies logical cognition and its development in infants and children, combining developmental psychology, vision science, and psycholinguistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的认知逻辑及其发展，结合发展心理学、视觉科学和语义语言学的方法。

faculty.name: Steve Chang
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain computes social preferences and mediates prosocial and antisocial decisions using neurophysiological, neuropharmacological, and neuroimaging techniques during social.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何计算社会偏好并调节亲社会和反社会决策，使用神经生理学、神经药理学和功能性神经成像技术在社会互动中进行研究。

faculty.name: Marvin Chun
faculty.summary: Studies visual attention, memory, and decision-making using fMRI to decode brain activity and predict individual differences in behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究视觉注意力、记忆和决策制定，解码大脑活动并预测个体行为差异。

faculty.name: Margaret Clark
faculty.summary: Studies how people form and maintain close relationships, focusing on emotional processes and interpersonal dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何建立和维持亲密关系，重点关注情绪过程和人际动态。

faculty.name: Lila Davachi
faculty.summary: Studies how memory encoding, consolidation, and retrieval work, using cognitive neuroscientific methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆编码、巩固和检索的认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Yarrow Dunham
faculty.summary: Studies how social groups are formed and their effects on cognition, using experiments and cross-cultural methods with adults and children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会群体的形成及其对认知的影响，使用实验和跨文化方法研究成人和儿童。

faculty.name: Melissa Ferguson
faculty.summary: Studies implicit cognitive processes that influence evaluation, self-control, and social behavior, focusing on updating impressions of others, controlling behavior, and expressing prejudice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究隐含的认知过程如何影响评价、自我控制和社会行为，重点关注更新对他人的印象、控制行为和表达偏见。

faculty.name: Dylan Gee
faculty.summary: Studies how early environments affect emotional learning and regulation in the brain, with implications for mental health disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期环境如何影响情绪学习和调节的大脑机制，对心理健康障碍具有重要意义。

faculty.name: Randolph Helfrich
faculty.summary: Studies the circuit and network mechanisms of higher cognitive functions like goal-directed attention and cognitive control using multimodal cognitive neurophysiology, combining electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知功能（如目标导向注意力和认知控制）的电路和网络机制，采用多模态认知神经生理学方法，结合电生理学、成像和刺激技术。

faculty.name: Julian Jara-Ettinger
faculty.summary: Studies social intelligence, including fairness, communication, and moral reasoning, using computational modeling and eye-tracking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会智能，包括公平性、沟通和道德推理，使用计算建模和眼动追踪技术。

faculty.name: Jutta Joormann
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and emotion regulation in depression and anxiety, using cognitive tasks, psychophysiological measures, and brain imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究抑郁和焦虑中的认知过程和情绪调节，使用认知任务、生理心理测量和脑成像方法。

faculty.name: Frank Keil
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults construct and evaluate causal interpretations of the world, focusing on gaps in knowledge and the role of experts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何构建和评估对世界的因果解释，重点关注知识缺口以及专家的作用。

faculty.name: Julia Leonard
faculty.summary: Studies how children decide when to exert effort, using behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging methods with diverse populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童在不同环境输入下如何适当地分配努力，使用行为、计算和神经影像学方法，涵盖不同年龄段的群体。

faculty.name: Gregory McCarthy
faculty.summary: Studies the functional organization of the human brain, focusing on social perception and cognition, and the neuroscience of executive processing and working memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑的功能组织，重点关注社会知觉和认知以及执行处理和工作记忆的神经科学。

faculty.name: Samuel McDougle
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive processes involved in motor skill acquisition and performance, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, neuroimaging, and neuropsychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程在运动技能获取和表现中的作用，使用行为实验、计算建模、神经影像学和神经心理学方法。

faculty.name: Wendy Berry Mendes
faculty.summary: Studies how emotion and stress affect decision-making and physiology, using autonomic nervous system physiology, neuroendocrinology, and facial EMG in various contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和压力如何影响决策和生理功能，使用自主神经系统生理学、神经内分泌学和面部肌电图在不同情境中进行研究。

faculty.name: Kia Nobre
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain anticipates, prioritizes, and selects information to form experience and guide behavior, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何预测、优先处理和选择信息以形成经验和指导行为，使用行为和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Jennifer Richeson
faculty.summary: Studies how people experience and respond to racial and societal diversity, including managing discrimination threats and political consequences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何体验和应对种族和社会多样性，包括应对歧视威胁和政治后果。

faculty.name: Micaela Rodriguez
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological functions and consequences of solitude, the role of digital technologies in social connection, and relationships with nonhuman entities, using diverse methodologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究独处的心理功能及其后果、数字技术在社会连接中的作用以及与非人类实体的关系，采用多种方法。

faculty.name: Robb Rutledge
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between decision making and emotion using computational models, neuroimaging, and smartphone data.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算模型、神经成像和智能手机数据研究决策制定与情绪之间的关系。

faculty.name: Peter Salovey
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological significance and function of human moods and emotions, and the effectiveness of programs teaching emotional intelligence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类情绪的心理意义和功能，以及教授情绪智力的项目效果。

faculty.name: Laurie Santos
faculty.summary: Studies the evolutionary origins of human cognition and the science of happiness, teaching students how to make better life choices.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知的进化起源和幸福科学，教授学生如何做出更好的生活选择。

faculty.name: Brian Scholl
faculty.summary: Studies visual cognition, including visual awareness, object persistence, and causality perception, using experiments with humans and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉认知，包括视觉意识、物体持久性和因果性知觉，使用人类和计算模型实验。

faculty.name: David Silverman
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and social factors contributing to achievement and well-being disparities among young people, using both laboratory experiments and longitudinal studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理和社会因素对年轻人群体成就和福祉差异的影响，采用实验室实验和纵向研究相结合的方法。

faculty.name: Brenden Tervo-Clemmens
faculty.summary: Studies individual variability in adolescent mental health risk and resilience through precision brain health approaches, integrating brain imaging, behavioral studies, and smartphone assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年心理健康风险和复原力的个体差异，通过精准脑健康方法，结合脑成像、行为研究和智能手机评估。

faculty.name: Nick Turk-Browne
faculty.summary: Studies how perception, attention, learning, and memory interact using psychophysical experiments, fMRI, case studies, and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、注意力、学习和记忆之间的相互作用，使用心理物理学实验、功能性磁共振成像、病例研究和计算模型。

faculty.name: Shirley Wang
faculty.summary: Develops and uses novel methods like machine learning and ambulatory assessment to model the complexity of mental health disorders, focusing on suicide, self-injury, and eating disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和运用机器学习和移动监测等方法，建模精神障碍的复杂性，重点关注自杀、自伤和进食障碍。

faculty.name: Lauren Whitehurst
faculty.summary: Studies how social inequities affect sleep quality and cognitive outcomes, using neuroscience to advance health equity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会不平等如何影响睡眠质量和认知结果，利用神经科学促进健康公平。

faculty.name: Ilker Yildirim
faculty.summary: Studies how the mind implements algorithms in neural activity and online psychological processes, focusing on visual cognition and object perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过神经活动实现心理过程中的算法，重点关注视觉认知和物体知觉。

faculty.name: Nii Addy
faculty.summary: Studies mechanisms of substance use and mood disorders, focusing on cholinergic, dopaminergic, and L-type calcium channel pathways.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物质使用和情绪障碍的机制，重点关注胆碱能、多巴胺能和L型钙通道途径。

faculty.name: AZA Allsop
faculty.summary: Studies how listening to music during social interactions affects brain activity and social connectedness, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音乐在面对面社交互动中对大脑活动和社会连接性的影响，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Amy Arnsten
faculty.summary: Studies molecular influences on prefrontal cortex functions, focusing on working memory and cognitive disorders, using multi-disciplinary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层功能的分子影响，重点关注工作记忆和认知障碍，采用多学科方法。

faculty.name: Hilary Blumberg
faculty.summary: Studies the biological and environmental factors affecting mood disorders like bipolar disorder and depression, using MRI and other techniques to identify markers and develop treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪障碍（如双相情感障碍和抑郁症）的生物学和环境因素，使用MRI等技术识别生物标志物并开发治疗方法。

faculty.name: Hal Blumenfeld
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of consciousness and impaired consciousness in epilepsy, using neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意识的神经机制及其在癫痫中的受损情况，使用神经成像、电生理学和动物模型。

faculty.name: Jessica Cardin
faculty.summary: Studies the dynamic relationship between neurons and networks in the cortex, focusing on synaptic interactions and gain control mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层中神经元与网络之间的动态关系，重点在于突触交互作用和增益控制机制。

faculty.name: Steve W. C. Chang
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuit mechanisms of social cognition and social decision-making using naturalistic social interaction paradigms and advanced behavioral and neural technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知和社会决策的神经回路机制，使用自然社会互动范式和先进的行为和神经技术。

faculty.name: Alicia Che
faculty.summary: Studies how oxytocin influences the development of social touch and fear extinction in the brain, using mouse genetics and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究催产素在社会触觉和恐惧消退中的作用，使用小鼠遗传学和成像技术。
